crossRefs.note: Behold, they brought to him a man who was paralyzed, lying on a bed. Jesus, seeing their faith, said to the paralytic…
Four people came, carrying a paralytic to him.
A certain man was there who had been sick for thirty-eight years.
When Jesus saw him lying there, and knew that he had been sick for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to be made…
There he found a certain man named Aeneas, who had been bedridden for eight years, because he was paralyzed.

translations.web: Behold, men brought a paralyzed man on a cot, and they sought to bring him in to lay before Jesus.
translations.bsb: Just then some men came carrying a paralyzed man on a mat. They tried to bring him inside to set him before Jesus,
translations.kjv: And, behold, men brought in a bed a man which was taken with a palsy: and they sought means to bring him in, and to lay him before him.
translations.asv: And behold, men bring on a bed a man that was palsied: and they sought to bring him in, and to lay him before him.
